maintenance_led.reason: Sells new building materials (engineered wood, plywood, lumber) and distributes products mainly for new residential construction.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are dealers, home improvement centers and builders, paid by private housing and commercial construction demand.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own distribution branches and mills, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Wholesale lumber, panels and building materials are largely interchangeable; customers can switch suppliers fairly easily.
